title: ADCO Industries – Headless E-Commerce Platform
description: Headless e-commerce platform with 3D virtual store, Shopify Storefront API, and Lighthouse score 85+.
longDescription: Production-grade headless e-commerce built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Strapi CMS — Lighthouse 85+. Integrated Shopify Storefront API for cart, checkout, and order management. Built an interactive 3D virtual store with Three.js. Deployed on AWS with CDN caching, dynamic imports, SSR, and CI/CD pipelines for peak SEO and performance.

title: Best Rooms Only (BRO) – Property Booking Platform
description: Property booking platform with real-time search, RBAC authentication, and SSR-powered SEO performance.
longDescription: Full-stack booking platform with real-time search, multi-criteria filtering, and complete reservation workflows. Implemented RBAC for secure admin and user management. Leveraged Next.js SSR and static generation for strong Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, FID). Built responsive UI with Tailwind CSS, connected to RESTful backend APIs

title: VoiceAgent – Real-Time AI Voice Interaction System
description: Real-time AI voice app — STT → LLM reasoning → TTS, built for low-latency conversations.
longDescription: Real-time AI voice system integrating speech-to-text, LLM reasoning (OpenAI/Gemini), and text-to-speech into a seamless pipeline. Async, event-driven architecture minimizes end-to-end latency. Context-aware processing maintains conversation state for accurate LLM responses. React.js frontend backed by a Python async pipeline.

title: AppointmentBot – AI-Powered Scheduling Assistant
description: Conversational AI agent for booking, updating, and cancelling appointments using LangGraph, Groq API, and NLP.
longDescription: Built an agentic AI scheduling assistant with LangGraph-powered multi-step reasoning and Groq API for low-latency LLM inference. Handles natural language requests to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments via an NLP-driven conversation flow. FastAPI backend manages appointment state and business logic; React.js frontend delivers a clean, chat-based interface. Designed with an event-driven agent loop to maintain context across multi-turn conversations.

title: Forest Meadows – Property Showcase Website
description: SEO-optimized property website for a Salem development featuring an interactive 3D site map with hotspots and lead capture forms.
longDescription: Developed a production-ready property showcase website for Forest Meadows, Salem, using Next.js and Strapi CMS. Built an interactive 3D site-map model with clickable hotspots to help buyers visually navigate the property layout. Integrated context-aware lead capture forms across multiple touchpoints to maximize conversions. Implemented SEO best practices — structured data, SSR, dynamic meta tags, and Core Web Vitals optimization — for strong organic search visibility.
